player_0.content: New plan: I failed to sort the list correctly because I didn't consider the correct order of the words. In the previous attempts, I noticed that the words were sorted correctly when they were shorter. In this case, the list contained a mix of short and long words. Next time, I will sort the list by first arranging the short words (less than 7 letters) in alphabetical order, and then the long words (8 letters or more) in alphabetical order. This way, I can ensure that the list is sorted correctly, regardless of the length of the words.
